news.headline: GE Vernova Showcases Low-Carbon Energy Solutions at 9th China International Import Expo
news.summary: GE Vernova presented its integrated low-carbon energy transition solutions at the 9th China International Import Expo in Shanghai, which concluded on November 10, 2026.

news.headline: GE Vernova to Supply Onshore Wind Turbines for German Wind Farm
news.summary: GE Vernova has signed an agreement with German utility Stadtwerke Heidenheim AG to supply three onshore wind turbines for the Schlotberg-Jüchsen wind farm.

news.headline: GE Vernova Signs Agreement To Supply Stadtwerke Heidenheim With Three 5.5 MW-158m Onshore Wind Turbines For Schlotberg-Jüchsen Wind Farm In Germany, Including 20-Year Service Agreement
